description: Build chart-ready data for a concise QBP Lite report from reproducible public BankFind quarterly financials. Includes executive snapshot metrics, trend series, community-bank comparison data, source notes, and explicit exclusions for non-public or non-BankFind QBP items.

include_community_banks.description: Include a compact community-bank-vs-industry comparison using the public community-bank flag.

repdte.description: Quarter-end Report Date (REPDTE) in YYYYMMDD format. If omitted, the tool searches backward from the latest likely published quarter until data is found.

trend_quarters.description: Number of quarterly observations to return for trend charts, including the current quarter. Default 20 quarters.

name: fdic_qbp_lite_data
title: Generate QBP Lite Data Bundle
